mapper.select: select draft_id, survey_id, client_token, draft_json, update_time from biz_survey_draft where survey_id = #{surveyId} and client_token = #{clientToken} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_survey_draft (survey_id, client_token, draft_json, update_time) values (#{surveyId}, #{clientToken}, #{draftJson}, now()) on conflict (survey_id, client_token) do update set draft_json = excluded.draft_json, update_time = now()
mapper.delete: delete from biz_survey_draft where survey_id = #{surveyId} and client_token = #{clientToken}
